# image annotation

The act of adding regions, labels, scene-graph edges, or other structured metadata to an image. Produces gmeow:ImageRegion and gmeow:SceneGraphEdge instances.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/eventTypeImageAnnotation>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:eventTypeImageAnnotation`  

**Type:** `gmeow:EventType`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/events>
